checks: The single combined notebook contains all four problems and all 28 code cells, executed in order without errors; its HTML contains the author, problem headings and embedded plots.
The shared seed-42 split covers 3,670 images exactly once, with 2,569/550/551 non-overlapping train/validation/test records.
Problem 2 contains all four controlled conditions, matching initial weights and split digests, complete 30-epoch histories, validation-selected checkpoints and recomputed full-test metrics.
Both VGG stages use the entire test split and validation-selected histories; stage 1 preserves official ImageNet features, stage 2 preserves blocks 1-4, and each gallery covers all five classes.
Grad-CAM identifies the selected stage-2 model and single conv5_3 target, uses the fixed validation image and records finite numerical maps, class targets and unchanged weights.
